name: React Starter Kit
summary: Full-stack monorepo template for SaaS apps on React 19, tRPC and Cloudflare Workers, with auth and billing included.
description: An opinionated full-stack boilerplate for building SaaS web apps on the edge: React 19, TanStack Router and TanStack Query, Tailwind CSS v4 and shadcn/ui on the frontend, Hono and tRPC on the backend, Drizzle ORM on Neon PostgreSQL, plus an Astro marketing site. Better Auth (email OTP, passkey, Google OAuth), organizations and Stripe subscriptions are wired up, and three Cloudflare Workers deploy independently.
contains: full-stack monorepo with three Cloudflare Workers: web, app and api
React 19, TanStack Router and TanStack Query, Tailwind CSS v4, shadcn/ui, Jotai
type-safe API with Hono and tRPC; Drizzle ORM on Neon PostgreSQL
Better Auth with email OTP, passkey and Google OAuth; organizations and Stripe subscriptions
Terraform provisioning and Cloudflare deployment guide
merge-seed skill for pulling upstream updates with a coding agent
